scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a monthly budget of INR 5,000, [X] must reserve money for a farewell saree and ticket and for a trip early next month, leaving room for only two or three summer tops that can serve ordinary days now and be packed for the trip rather than buying a separate top for every setting.
examples: choosing two or three tops that can repeat across ordinary summer days
checking whether the same small rotation can be packed for the upcoming trip
balancing occasion range against money already committed to the farewell and travel
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 每月只有 5000 卢比预算时，[X]还要为欢送会的纱丽和门票以及下月初的旅行留钱，因此夏季上衣只能买两三件；这组精简上衣既要应付眼下的普通日常，也能直接装进旅行行李，而不是为每种场合各买一件。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After committing to twenty minutes of movement on six days each week through brisk walks, short home sessions, or cycling, [X] plans tops around the transition from a presentable workday to immediate light exercise, distinguishing when one upper layer can span both settings from when a quick change is more practical.
examples: moving directly from desk work into a brisk walk
keeping a separate top ready for a short home workout
deciding whether an occasional bike ride requires a more activity-specific upper layer
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 决定每周六天各活动 20 分钟，并在快走、居家短训和骑行之间选择后，[X]会围绕从体面工作状态直接切换到轻运动来安排上衣，判断何时同一件上装可以跨越两个场合，何时快速换衣更实际。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a seven-day Bali trip, [X] builds a five- or six-top capsule for humid sightseeing, beach and surfing time, temple visits, yoga, a Mount Batur hike, and relaxed evenings, assessing each top by which fixed itinerary parts it covers and whether the rotation stays small enough to rewear and layer.
examples: separating a beach or surf top from temple-appropriate upper coverage
using one breathable top across sightseeing and a casual evening
packing an upper layer that can join the early hike without bloating the capsule
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为期七天的巴厘岛旅行中，[X]会用五六件上衣覆盖湿热观光、海滩和冲浪、寺庙参访、瑜伽、巴杜尔火山徒步以及轻松夜间活动；每件上衣都按能覆盖行程中的哪些环节来判断，同时整组还要便于重复穿着和叠搭。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When beginning a weight-loss routine, [X] settles on morning walks before work and evening jump-rope sessions three times a week, distinguishing tops for an easy outdoor start from those suited to repeated high-impact movement while keeping preparation and washing simple enough to sustain.
examples: using a low-friction top for an easy walk before the workday
changing for jump-rope sessions that create more heat and movement
keeping enough repeatable options for a three-times-weekly routine
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始减重时，[X]会选择工作前晨走，并在每周三个晚上跳绳；上衣需要区分适合清晨轻松户外活动的类型和适合晚间反复高冲击动作的类型，同时让准备与清洗负担足够低，才能持续执行。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] plans a breathable base top and removable upper layer for queues, stairs, dense crowd heat, dancing, and the cooler trip home, judging the choice by how naturally it moves across waiting, active, and late-night phases rather than by appearance alone.
examples: keeping the base comfortable while standing and dancing in a dense crowd
removing a flannel, shirt, bomber, or hoodie when the stadium becomes warm
putting the extra layer back on for the trip home
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了参加 R&B 体育场演唱会，[X]会计划透气打底上衣和可脱卸外层，以应对排队、爬楼梯、拥挤热气、跳舞以及较凉的返程；选择依据不是单看外观，而是上装能否自然跨越等待、活动和深夜离场几个阶段。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With army-green suits fixed for the wedding party, [X] coordinates the shirt and upper details for preparation, ceremony, formal photographs, dinner, and dancing, requiring the top to remain appropriate beside the suits and neckwear through both highly formal and more active parts of the wedding.
examples: coordinating a shirt with the army-green suit and the group's ties or bow ties
keeping the upper look consistent during ceremony and group photographs
remaining comfortable when the reception shifts into dinner and dancing
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 婚礼团队已经确定穿军绿色西装后，[X]会为准备、仪式、正式合影、晚宴和跳舞协调衬衫及上身细节；上衣既要与固定西装和领饰相称，也要覆盖婚礼中高度正式与更活跃的不同阶段。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a surprise birthday day with a husband, [X] combines breakfast, a shared activity such as a hike or yoga, lunch, an experience or gift reveal, and an evening dinner, deciding whether one top can cross the casual, active, and dressed-up phases or a small change is worth planning.
examples: starting with a relaxed top for breakfast together
allowing for a shared hike or yoga option without fixing the whole day around sportswear
changing the upper look before an intimate evening dinner or gift reveal
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为丈夫安排惊喜生日时，[X]会把早餐、徒步或瑜伽等共同活动、午餐、体验或礼物揭晓，以及晚间约会餐组合起来，并判断一件上衣能否跟随这一天跨越休闲、活动和稍正式阶段，还是值得预留一次小幅换装。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a ten-day Ireland golf and countryside trip, [X] plans tops across several rounds, car transfers, village or countryside sightseeing, clubhouse time, and relaxed evenings, requiring the rotation to handle changing outdoor exposure and social expectations without treating every round or stop as a separate wardrobe.
examples: layering an upper look for exposed time on a golf course
moving from a round into a clubhouse or meal without a full outfit reset
reusing casual tops for drives, countryside walks, and relaxed evenings
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为期十天的爱尔兰高尔夫与乡村旅行中，[X]会安排上衣覆盖多轮球局、驾车转场、村镇或乡间观光、俱乐部空间和轻松夜晚；整组上衣需要应对变化的户外暴露和社交要求，而不能把每轮球或每一站都当成独立衣橱。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a Christmas trip to Las Vegas with long walks, free city attractions, one festive evening, and a possible nature outing, [X] keeps the upper-body packing list lean, uses light layers for large day-to-night temperature changes, and reserves a distinctive top for the holiday event that matters most.
examples: repeating simple tops during long daytime walks and free attractions
adding warmth for cool evenings without buying several special outfits
saving one more festive upper look for the chosen Christmas event
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划圣诞节去拉斯维加斯，主要活动是长距离步行、免费城市景点、一场节日晚间活动和可能的自然景点出行时，[X]会压缩上衣清单，用轻薄叠穿应对昼夜温差，并只为最重要的节日活动保留一件更有辨识度的上衣。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon college reunion on campus, [X] compares a sweater with a polo, button-down, or T-shirt-and-overshirt combination, choosing an upper option that feels approachable during walking and conversation yet polished enough for meeting former classmates and appearing in informal group photographs.
examples: keeping a sweater relaxed beside dark jeans and casual footwear
using a polo or button-down when a slightly neater reunion look is preferred
choosing a T-shirt and overshirt combination that can adjust through the afternoon
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了参加校园里的休闲下午同学会，[X]会比较针织衫、Polo 衫、纽扣衬衫以及 T 恤加外搭衬衫的组合；上装既要便于走动和交谈、显得亲切，也要在重逢旧同学和非正式合影时足够利落。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A survey worker who is also a parent builds a small repeatable upper-body rotation for very early school drop-off, home or office analysis, in-person field interviews, phone callbacks, school pickup, and evening care. The work role is indispensable because each top is judged by how well it crosses respondent-facing, desk-based, travel, and family phases without forcing an impractical number of changes.
examples: staying presentable for respondent-facing interviews after an early school run
switching between field travel and home data work with a small rotation
keeping school pickup and evening care compatible with the day's work layer
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名兼顾育儿的调查工作者需要建立一组可重复的上衣轮换，以覆盖很早的送学、居家或办公室分析、现场访谈、电话回访、接孩子和晚间照护。职业身份不可替代，因为每件上衣都要在面对受访者、伏案、转场和家庭阶段之间切换，又不能造成不现实的频繁换装。
